name: Event Creation Flow
description: Hosts create events via web (luma.com/create), iOS, or Android by filling in title, date/time, timezone, event type (in-person/online/hybrid), cover image, description, theme, and calendar assignment, then publishing immediately.
evidence_quote: Creating an event on Luma is quick and easy… Fill in the basic information (title, date, location, description), choose a cover image and theme, click 'Create Event'. Your event will be created instantly.

name: Event Types: In-Person, Online, Hybrid
description: Hosts choose between in-person (address + map), online (meeting link with per-guest unique join URLs), or hybrid (physical + online combined) when creating an event.
evidence_quote: Event Type: Choose the type of event you're hosting: In-Person, Online (for virtual events via Zoom, Google Meet, or other platforms), Hybrid (for events with both physical and online attendance options).

name: Multi-Session / Recurring Events via Clone
description: Recurring or multi-session events are created by cloning an existing event with different dates; up to 30 clones can be created at once with settings duplicated but guest lists kept separate.
evidence_quote: The easiest way to create multiple sessions is to use the Clone Event feature. This allows you to quickly duplicate an event with different dates and times - you can create up to 30 events at once.

name: Event Page Structure
description: Each event page shows a cover image, title, date/time, host profile(s), location or meeting link, description, registration/RSVP button, guest list (optional), and event theme/visual effects.
evidence_quote: On the Luma Event Page, they can register for the event… The name and email are required for all guests who register on this form.

name: Event Page Themes & Visual Customization
description: Hosts choose from 40+ visual themes (Minimal, Confetti, Emoji, Pattern, Seasonal, Warp) with animated effects; colors are customizable; live preview available during event creation.
evidence_quote: Luma makes it really easy to personalize your event with beautiful themes on luma.com/create. Choose from over 40 stunning themes to match your event's personality.

name: Event Visibility Settings
description: Hosts set events to Public (discoverable, indexable by search engines), Private (link-only, not listed), or Member-Only (visible only to active calendar members with a paid membership).
evidence_quote: Public: Events are shown on your calendar and eligible to be featured on Discover calendars. Private: Unlisted events that won't show on any calendar. Member-Only: Only shown to active members of your calendar membership.

name: Location Privacy (Restrict Location to Guests)
description: Hosts can hide the precise venue address from non-approved visitors; the event page shows only the city and approximate area until a guest is approved.
evidence_quote: Visitors to the event page will still see the city and approximate location of the event but they won't see the address or the precise location.

name: Ticket Types
description: Hosts create multiple ticket types per event with configurable name, price (free, fixed, or flexible/sliding-scale with minimum), approval requirement, sales date windows, and per-ticket capacity limits.
evidence_quote: Payment Type — Free or Paid. For a paid ticket, you can choose the price in any supported currency. You can also make the amount flexible and set a minimum and suggested prices. Dates / Capacity — These are advanced features that allow you to restrict when the ticket type is available.

name: Registration Approval (Require Approval)
description: Per ticket type, hosts can require manual approval; registrants enter a 'Pending' state until the host approves or rejects them, with customizable approval/rejection emails.
evidence_quote: Require Approval — On or Off. With require approval on, guests will become 'Pending' once they register. We support this for both free and paid tickets.

name: Capacity & Waitlist
description: Hosts set a maximum event capacity; when reached, new registrants automatically join a waitlist; for paid waitlists, payment is authorized but only captured on approval.
evidence_quote: The waitlist feature allows hosts to manage overflow demand when their event reaches capacity. For paid tickets, guests authorize payment when they join the waitlist, and they are only charged if you approve them from the waitlist.

name: Group Registration (Plus-Ones / Multi-Ticket)
description: Hosts enable group registration so a single registrant can purchase multiple tickets in one checkout; no per-attendee information collection is supported for additional tickets.
evidence_quote: If you are hosting an event where a guest may want to register for multiple tickets, you can turn on Group Registration from your event… When a guest registers, they'll be able to select how many tickets they'd like to register for before checking out.

name: Token Gating (Crypto / NFT Access Control)
description: Hosts require guests to connect a crypto wallet holding a specific ERC-20 or ERC-721 token on Ethereum to register; combinable with paid tickets or approval-required tickets.
evidence_quote: You can require token gating for Luma events — guests will have to link their wallet and have the appropriate token in their wallet in order to register for the event. This supports ERC-20 and ERC-721 tokens on Ethereum.

name: Custom Registration Questions
description: Hosts add custom form fields to the registration flow (text, options, social profiles, company, checkbox, terms/signature, website); answers visible in guest detail view and CSV export.
evidence_quote: We have the following question types: Text — Short or Long Text; Options — Choose One or Multiple; Social Profile — Instagram, X (Twitter), LinkedIn, YouTube; Company; Checkbox; Terms — Useful for requiring someone to sign terms and conditions; Website.

name: Guest Check-In (QR Scan + Express Mode)
description: Hosts scan guest QR codes via the Luma iOS/Android app or web scanner; Standard Mode shows guest details before confirming; Express Mode auto-checks in on scan for high-volume events.
evidence_quote: For large events where you need to quickly process many guests, you can enable Express Mode. This mode automatically checks guests in as soon as you scan their QR code, eliminating the need to tap a button for each guest.

name: Check-In Manager Role
description: Hosts grant a check-in-only role to staff or volunteers who can scan tickets and view the guest list but cannot edit the event or send messages; requires Luma Plus.
evidence_quote: You can give team members check-in access without granting them full event management permissions… Check-in staff requires Luma Plus.

name: Event Blasts (Host-to-Attendee Messaging)
description: Hosts send or schedule messages to attendees (filtered by registration status or ticket type) via email, SMS, and push notification; advanced mode supports rich text, images, and attachments.
evidence_quote: Blasts will be sent via email, SMS, and push notifications… From there, you can write much longer messages with no character limit using our Rich Text Editor — including headings, images, buttons, attachments, and event embeds.

name: Event Insights & Analytics
description: Hosts see page views, live traffic, top referrers, top cities, custom UTM-source tracking, and guest referral attribution; online events track join-link clicks and Zoom attendance.
evidence_quote: Page Views — We show the number of pages views… Top Referrers — We automatically track links to luma.com… Top Sources — Here you can define custom tracking links with a utm_source.

name: Calendars (Community/Host Page with Event Collections)
description: Each host has a Personal Calendar and can create Team Calendars; a calendar is a public page listing the host's events, supports subscribers, newsletter sending, membership tiers, and event tagging for filtering.
evidence_quote: Every event on Luma belongs to a calendar… Team Calendar: Created for organizations, companies, or groups. Multiple people can be added as admins to manage all events. Better branding options and customization for your organization.

name: Calendar Newsletters
description: Calendar admins send or schedule email newsletters to all subscribers or to filtered segments by tag or membership tier; includes rich text editor, open/click stats, and draft auto-save.
evidence_quote: Newsletters let you communicate directly with your calendar's people… By Membership Tier sends only to members of a specific membership tier. This is useful for member-only content or tier-specific announcements.

name: Calendar Membership (Paid Subscriptions for Hosts)
description: Calendar owners offer paid recurring membership tiers; members get access to member-only events and content; subscribers manage and cancel at luma.com/settings/payment.
evidence_quote: If you've joined a calendar membership with recurring payment, you can find details and manage your subscription at your payment settings page… Once canceled, you'll continue to have membership access until the end of your current billing period.

name: Paid Ticket Sales & Payment Methods
description: Hosts sell tickets via Stripe; payment methods include credit cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and regional methods (iDEAL, Konbini, PayNow); platform fee is 5% on Free plan and 0% on Luma Plus.
evidence_quote: Accept all credit cards, Apple Pay & Google Pay. Accept regional payment methods such as iDEAL, Konbini and PayNow. 5% platform fee for paid events [Free]. 0% platform fee for paid events [Luma Plus].

name: Discover / City Explore Pages
description: Luma curates featured events on city explore pages in 50+ cities worldwide, organized by category (Tech, AI, Food & Drink, etc.); hosts can submit events for curation consideration.
evidence_quote: We have explore pages in over 50 cities around the world where we feature high quality, interesting events… Getting featured can greatly increase the number of registrations and ticket sales for an event.

name: Social Proof: Guest List Visibility & Referral Links
description: Event pages optionally display the attendee list for social proof; each registered guest gets a personal share link that attributes referrals and is tracked in the host's Insights tab.
evidence_quote: When you register for an event as a guest, you will get prompted to share a link for other people to join you at the event… The event host can see who has invited other people to join on the Insights tab of the event.

name: Automated Notifications & Reminders
description: Luma automatically sends event reminders 1 day and 1 hour before in-person events, plus post-event feedback requests; guests control channels (email, SMS/WhatsApp, push) via notification preferences.
evidence_quote: Event Reminders — Reminders before an event you're attending. Available on Email, SMS, and Push. Feedback Requests — Post-event survey requests from the host. Available on Email only.

name: iCal Subscription & Embedded Calendar Widget
description: Users subscribe to a live iCal feed of their Luma events (hosting, attending, invited) or to any public calendar or city page; hosts embed a calendar widget or registration button on external websites.
evidence_quote: Luma offers iCal subscriptions that sync your events to external calendar apps like Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, and Outlook. These are live subscriptions — your calendar app periodically fetches the latest data from Luma, so changes are reflected automatically.
